quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on Kevin Durant's competitive personality and character
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just his personality, the way he carries himself, how hard he plays.
quotes.quote: I think it's just his personality, the way he carries himself, how hard he plays. I think fans appreciate when people play hard and are competitive on every night, and he is one of those guys. I would say that, but also he is a really good person to be around. Obviously other people from outside don't see it, but when you get to be around him, he is a really good dude and cares a lot about his teammates and is always looking out for people.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie on Kevin Durant: He is a really good person to be around. Obviously other people from outside do not see it, but when you get to be around him, he is a really good dude and cares a lot about his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on his approach to shooting and reading defenses
quotes.excerpt: It is really just reading what the defense gives us. If they are in a drop coverage.
quotes.quote: It is really just reading what the defense gives us. If they are in a drop coverage, I am going to try and come off and shoot it. Obviously if there is longer defenders, if it is a guy like Wembanyama where he can do a little bit of both, you have to read the situation. But if it is there, I work on it a lot, so I will take it.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie on his offensive approach: It is really just reading what the defense gives us. If they are in a drop coverage, I am going to try and come off and shoot it.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on Kevin Durant's shooting efficiency and mindset
quotes.excerpt: I just told him, I was like, shoot first and ask questions later.
quotes.quote: I just told him, I was like, shoot first and ask questions later. You shoot 48% from three, which is ridiculous. I just told him, I was like, shoot that. He was like, I am like, shoot first and ask questions after.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie is encouraging Kevin Durant to be more aggressive from deep: I just told him, shoot first and ask questions later. You shoot 48 percent from three, which is ridiculous.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on Michael Porter Jr.'s shot-making ability
quotes.excerpt: Michael Porter Jr. might be the best tough shot maker and workout shooter I have ever seen.
quotes.quote: Michael Porter Jr. might be the best tough shot maker and workout shooter I have ever seen in my life.
quotes.social_post: High praise from Collin Gillespie for Michael Porter Jr.: He might be the best tough shot maker and workout shooter I have ever seen in my life.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on finding his role and playing off the ball
quotes.excerpt: I have just been able to find ways to play off the ball, catching and shooting.
quotes.quote: I have just been able to find ways to play off the ball, catching and shooting, playing get action, pick and roll threes. I think my superpower is shooting and finding ways to get those off.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie on his role with the Suns: I have just been able to find ways to play off the ball, catching and shooting, playing get action, pick and roll threes. I think my superpower is shooting.
